changeSet.author: openelis
changeSet.comment: Required additional fields contribute to generic sample completion. Historical samples missing a current required field remain pending until the field is completed through Sample Management.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE clinlims.sample_item sample_item SET data_completion_status = 'PENDING_COMPLETION' WHERE data_completion_status = 'COMPLETED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.sample_type_additional_field_def field_definition WHERE field_definition.type_of_sample_id = sample_item.typeosamp_id AND field_definition.active = TRUE AND field_definition.required = TRUE AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.sample_item_additional_field_value field_value WHERE field_value.sample_item_id = sample_item.id AND field_value.field_def_id = field_definition.id AND COALESCE(BTRIM(field_value.field_value), '') <> '' ) );
